screens.label: Initial Report Details Entry
screens.description: On this screen, you will enter the foundational details for the intake report. Guidance is provided for each field to ensure accurate and complete information. Please review instructions and fill out all required fields. This is the first step in documenting a new intake case.
data_validation: Intake date cannot be in the future.
Intake time must be a valid time format.
Summary must not be empty.

buttons.label: Next: Associated Individuals
buttons.description: Proceed to enter individuals linked to the case.

screens.label: Associated Individuals Entry
screens.description: Enter all individuals connected to the case. For each person, provide identifying and relationship details. You may add multiple individuals as needed. Instructions are provided for each field. Please ensure accuracy, especially for relationships and contact information.
data_validation: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
Cannot have more than one mother or father.
SSN must be unique among individuals.
If role is 'Alleged Victim', relationship must be to child.
Phone number must be valid format.

screens.label: Allegation Documentation
screens.description: Record all allegations related to the case. For each allegation, specify the type, involved individuals, and a detailed description. You may add multiple allegations. Guidance is provided for clarity and completeness.
data_validation: Date of alleged incident cannot be in the future.
Alleged victim and perpetrator cannot be the same individual.
Allegation description must not be empty.
Alleged victim must be listed in associated individuals.

screens.label: Reporter Information Entry
screens.description: Capture details about the person reporting the incident. Please provide as much information as possible. Some fields may be optional if the reporter wishes to remain anonymous. Instructions are provided for each field.
data_validation: If reporter type is 'Professional', organization is required.
Phone number must be valid format.
Email must be valid format if provided.

screens.label: Incident Details Documentation
screens.description: Document the specifics of the incident. Provide location, date, time, and a detailed narrative. This information is critical for understanding the context and severity of the case. Please follow the instructions and ensure all required fields are completed.

fields.label: Law Enforcement Notified
fields.error_message: Please indicate if law enforcement was notified.

data_validation: Incident date cannot be in the future.
Incident location must be valid address format.
If law enforcement notified, agency name is required.

buttons.description: Proceed to final review and submission.

actions.name: Validate Intake Data Entry Fields
actions.implementation: On each intake data entry screen, validate all required fields, including mandatory fields, correct formats, and logical consistency (e.g., dates not in future, plausible ages, unique SSNs). Highlight errors and prevent navigation until resolved.
actions.triggerCondition: User attempts to proceed to next screen or submit data

actions.name: Apply Business Logic to Intake Data Entry
actions.implementation: Apply cross-field business rules (e.g., only one mother/father, role/relationship consistency) on each screen. Display specific error messages for violations and prevent navigation until resolved.
actions.triggerCondition: User attempts to proceed to next screen or submit data

actions.name: Navigate Intake Data Entry Screens
actions.implementation: Enable navigation between intake data entry screens, including forward and backward movement. Allow user to edit any previous screen. Navigation is restricted if validation fails.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Next' or 'Previous' or selects a screen from breadcrumb

actions.name: Print Intake Data Entry Sequence
actions.implementation: Prints the current intake data entry sequence for review or record keeping using the eligibility_summary template.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Print' button

actions.name: Export Intake Data Entry Sequence as PDF
actions.implementation: Exports the entire intake data entry sequence as a PDF document for sharing or archiving.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Export PDF' button

steps.label: Search Prior History
steps.description: When the 'Search Prior History' button is clicked by the Intake Worker, the system must query the agency database for any prior reports, cases, or patterns associated with the child or household. The results of this query are displayed to the Intake Worker for review.

rules.label: Trigger Search
rules.logic: On 'Search Prior History' button click, initiate a query to the agency database using child and household identifiers.

rules.label: Query Database
rules.logic: Retrieve all prior reports, cases, or patterns linked to the child or household from the agency database.

rules.label: Display Results
rules.logic: Present the retrieved prior history data to the Intake Worker for review. If an error occurs (e.g., database error), display the error message from the functional data.

actions.name: Search Prior History
actions.implementation: On 'Search Prior History' button click, system queries the agency database for prior reports, cases, or patterns associated with the child or household. Results are displayed to the Intake Worker for review. If an error occurs, display the error message and provide options to retry or contact support.
actions.triggerCondition: Button 'Search Prior History' clicked by Intake Worker

actions.name: Handle Search Prior History Error
actions.implementation: If search fails, display error message, allow user to retry search, or contact support. Log error in audit trail.
actions.triggerCondition: Search Prior History fails

actions.name: Print Prior History Results
actions.implementation: Prints the prior history search results for record keeping.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Print' button

actions.name: Export Prior History Results as PDF
actions.implementation: Exports the prior history search results as a PDF document.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Export PDF' button

screens.description: Review all entered information for accuracy and completeness. You will see a summary of all report details, individuals, allegations, reporter, and incident information. Confirm that all required fields are filled and make corrections if needed. When ready, submit the intake for validation and processing.
data_validation: All mandatory fields must be completed before submission.
Dates must be valid and not in the future.
Dropdown selections must be made for all required fields.
Logical consistency across all sections.

actions.name: Validate Review and Submit Intake Fields
actions.implementation: On the Review and Submit Intake screen, validate that all mandatory fields across all sections are completed, dates are valid, dropdowns are selected, and logical consistency is maintained. Highlight errors and prevent submission until resolved.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Submit Intake' or attempts to proceed

actions.name: Navigate Review and Submit Intake Screens

actions.name: Submit Intake for Validation and Processing
actions.implementation: If all validations pass, submit intake for processing. Update audit trail and notify Intake Worker of successful submission. Route to Disposition Decision step.
actions.triggerCondition: User clicks 'Submit Intake' and validation passes

steps.label: Validate Intake Data
steps.description: Upon clicking 'Submit Intake', the system must validate all intake data for completeness and correctness. This includes checking that all mandatory fields are filled, date formats are correct, incident dates are not in the future, ages are plausible, and dropdown selections are valid. If any validation fails, the system must prompt the user to correct the errors before allowing submission.

rules.label: Mandatory Field Validation
rules.logic: Ensure all required fields are completed before submission.

rules.label: Date Format Validation
rules.logic: Check that all date fields are in the correct format and that incident dates are not set in the future.

rules.label: Logical Consistency
rules.logic: Verify that ages are plausible and dropdown selections are valid according to system constraints.

rules.label: Error Handling
rules.logic: If any validation fails, display an error message (using the 'message' field from functional data) and prevent submission until errors are corrected.

actions.name: Validate Intake Data on Submission
actions.implementation: On 'Submit Intake', system validates all intake data for completeness and correctness, including mandatory fields, date formats, logical consistency (incident dates not in future, plausible ages), and dropdown selections. If validation fails, display error messages, highlight fields needing correction, and allow user to edit any previous screen before resubmission.
actions.triggerCondition: Button 'Submit Intake' clicked by Intake Worker

actions.name: Edit Intake Data After Validation Failure
actions.implementation: If validation fails during submission, allow Intake Worker to return to any previous intake data entry screen to correct errors. Display specific error messages and guidance for correction.
actions.triggerCondition: Validation fails on 'Submit Intake'

steps.label: Disposition Decision
steps.description: The Intake Worker must review all facts, agency policy, and legal requirements before making a disposition decision. The worker selects either 'Screen In' (to assign for investigation/assessment) or 'Screen Out' (no further action required) and documents the rationale for the decision.

rules.label: Review Facts and Policy
rules.logic: Intake Worker reviews all available facts, agency policy, and legal requirements relevant to the case.

rules.label: Select Disposition
rules.logic: Intake Worker selects either 'Screen In' or 'Screen Out' as the disposition decision.

rules.label: Document Rationale
rules.logic: Intake Worker must provide a documented rationale for the selected disposition decision.

rules.label: Error Handling
rules.logic: If there is a system error (e.g., as indicated by the 'status' or 'message' fields in functional data), display the error message and prevent finalization of the disposition until resolved.

actions.name: Make Disposition Decision - Screen In
actions.implementation: Intake Worker reviews all facts, agency policy, and legal requirements. Selects 'Screen In' (assign for investigation/assessment) and documents rationale for the decision. If system error occurs, display error message and prevent finalization until resolved. Upon successful selection, update audit trail, notify supervisor, and route to Assign to Supervisor step.
actions.triggerCondition: Disposition decision 'Screen In' made and rationale documented by Intake Worker

actions.name: Make Disposition Decision - Screen Out
actions.implementation: Intake Worker reviews all facts, agency policy, and legal requirements. Selects 'Screen Out' (no further action required) and documents rationale for the decision. If system error occurs, display error message and prevent finalization until resolved. Upon successful selection, update audit trail, notify relevant parties, and route to Screen Out Documentation step.
actions.triggerCondition: Disposition decision 'Screen Out' made and rationale documented by Intake Worker

steps.label: Assign to Supervisor
steps.description: System automatically routes the completed intake record to the designated supervisor for review and approval. Access to the intake record is restricted based on user roles, ensuring only authorized supervisors can view and act on the record. The system updates the audit trail to log the assignment event, including timestamp, assigned supervisor, and initiating intake worker.

assignments.label: Assign to Supervisor
assignments.logic: Upon completion of intake by the Intake Worker, the system triggers a routing process that assigns the intake record to a supervisor based on agency configuration or workload rules. The system verifies user roles to restrict access, ensuring only supervisors can review and approve the intake. An audit trail entry is created to record the assignment event, capturing the intake record ID, assigned supervisor ID, initiating user ID, and timestamp.

actions.name: Assign Intake to Supervisor
actions.implementation: Upon selection of 'Screen In' disposition, system automatically routes the completed intake record to the designated supervisor for review and approval. Access is restricted based on user roles. Audit trail is updated with intake record ID, assigned supervisor ID, initiating user ID, and timestamp. System sends notification to the assigned supervisor.
actions.triggerCondition: Disposition decision is 'Screen In' and rationale documented

actions.name: Notify Supervisor of Intake Assignment
actions.implementation: Send notification (email and in-app) to assigned supervisor upon intake assignment. Log notification event in audit trail.
actions.triggerCondition: Intake assigned to supervisor

steps.label: Supervisor Review Task
steps.description: Supervisor reviews the completed intake record for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with agency policy. The system restricts access to supervisors, routes the intake record for review, and updates the audit trail upon action. Supervisor must approve or request changes before intake can proceed.

completionConditions.logic: Supervisor must review all intake details, confirm compliance with agency policy, and either approve the intake record or return it for corrections. Task is complete when supervisor approval is recorded in the system and audit trail is updated.

actions.name: Supervisor Approves Intake
actions.implementation: Supervisor reviews the completed intake record for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with agency policy. If approved, system records approval, updates audit trail, and sends notification to relevant parties. Workflow proceeds to next step as defined by agency policy.
actions.triggerCondition: Supervisor clicks 'Approve Intake' after reviewing all sections

actions.name: Supervisor Requests Correction
actions.implementation: Supervisor reviews intake and, if corrections are needed, provides comments and clicks 'Request Correction'. System routes intake back to Intake Worker for corrections, updates audit trail, and notifies Intake Worker.
actions.triggerCondition: Supervisor clicks 'Request Correction' and provides comments

actions.name: Print Supervisor Review
actions.implementation: Prints the supervisor intake review for record keeping.
actions.triggerCondition: Supervisor clicks 'Print' button

actions.name: Export Supervisor Review as PDF
actions.implementation: Exports the supervisor intake review as a PDF document.
actions.triggerCondition: Supervisor clicks 'Export PDF' button
